description: This file is a Java configuration class that sets up Spring Batch infrastructure within the project. It defines beans for a messaging channel and an interceptor, and is conditionally enabled based on a project property.

classes.name: ManagerConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up batch processing components, enabling batch integration and conditional bean instantiation based on application properties.

methods.name: outboundRequests
methods.description: Defines and returns a new DirectChannel bean used for outbound requests.

methods.name: outputInterceptor
methods.description: Defines and returns a new OutputChannelInterceptor bean used for intercepting output channel messages.
